data.name: Ahad
data.gender_notes: Ahad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ahad refers to the oneness of God, emphasizing unity and uniqueness. It signifies the singular nature of Allah in Islamic faith. The name Ahad carries the meaning “One and Only” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahad usually hope their child will grow to embody one and only and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ahad is derived from the Quranic concept of Tawhid, which emphasizes the oneness of God.
data.etymology: Ahad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One and Only.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahad total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
